top10.assumption: A construction SME will value construction-specific workflow implementation beyond the free/general Digital for Business diagnostic.
Decision support provides material value beyond raw eTenders alerts/search.
A useful bid/no-bid pre-screen can be produced from public notice/tender data plus a contractor capability profile without misrepresenting eligibility.
Pre-qualification can reduce poor retrofit leads without duplicating a registered OSS/contractor/SEAI role.
Lead data needed for eligibility can be collected early enough: MPRN/year/BER/HLI/insulation/measure/route.
Grant cash timing does not create a fatal working-capital/affordability gap.
The quote/job-document workflow has measurable cycle-time/rekey/rework pain.
Manual sample delivery can be completed at a sustainable service time/cost.
The public artifact can be kept current cheaply enough as tender/support rules change.
A buyer will pay for the resulting service.
